description: Greedy baseline policy: Always flip A→C when in contact with B catalyst. Uses hysteresis to prevent oscillation. This is the reference implementation that participants should try to beat.

state_transitions.description: When A patch is within 0.7 of B patch for 5 consecutive checks (500 timesteps), flip A→C with 100% probability

design_rationale.why_greedy: Always flipping when opportunity arises maximizes conversion rate
design_rationale.why_hysteresis_5: Balances responsiveness vs stability. Lower values cause oscillation, higher values slow convergence.
design_rationale.why_cutoff_0.7: Matches morse_rcut = 7 × patch_radius = 0.7, ensures flip only when patches are actually interacting
design_rationale.why_no_reverse: Simple forward-only reaction to establish baseline. Reversibility can be added for exploration.

improvement_directions: Add reversible C→A transition to escape kinetic traps
Tune cutoff based on morse_depth (stronger binding → larger effective range)
Adaptive hysteresis (different thresholds for A→C vs C→A)
